caption: The video showcases a rustic wall-mounted lamp fixed to a pale wall, with a rectangular wooden bracket, a thick rope looped over a horizontal arm, and a spherical open-weave rattan shade holding a warm bulb. The bulb is already glowing in the opening frame, while the whole scene is dark. Exposure then climbs steadily until the lamp, bracket, rope, and shade appear at normal brightness. A diagonal lattice shadow spreads across the wall to the left, and a vertical frame edge stands at the right. Throughout the clip, the lamp assembly keeps the same orientation and relative geometry, with no visible swing or deformation. A slight frame-wide drift shifts all elements together, leaving the glowing bulb and cast shadow essentially stable.
relations: Exposure increase raises brightness of bulb, wooden bracket, rope, and rattan shade together toward normal levels.
Diagonal lattice shadow on left wall and vertical frame edge on right persist as brightness climbs.
Lamp assembly orientation and relative geometry remain fixed while a slight frame-wide drift shifts all elements together.
Glowing bulb and cast shadow stay essentially stable despite the global drift and exposure change.
